WITH dw1 AS (
    SELECT 
        i_category,
        i_class,
        i_brand,
        i_product_name,
        d_year,
        d_qoy,
        d_moy,
        s_store_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(ss_sales_price * ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
    FROM 
        store_sales
    JOIN 
        date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN 
        store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
    JOIN 
        item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    WHERE 
        d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
    GROUP BY 
        i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id
)
SELECT 
    i_category,
    i_class,
    i_brand,
    i_product_name,
    d_year,
    d_qoy,
    d_moy,
    s_store_id,
    sumsales,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category ORDER BY sumsales DESC) AS rk
FROM 
    dw1
WHERE 
    rk <= 100
ORDER BY 
    i_category, i_class, i_brand, i_product_name, d_year, d_qoy, d_moy, s_store_id, sumsales, rk
LIMIT 100
